crypto_headlines.title: U.S. spot Bitcoin ETFs shed $411.9M Friday; week totals about $1.28B out
crypto_headlines.summary: Friday's net outflow was $411.9M, led by BlackRock's IBIT at $403M, while Fidelity's FBTC took in $42.8M. Across Nov 2–6 the funds recorded about $1.28B in net withdrawals, the largest weekly outflow in 19 weeks. Bitcoin traded near $76,000 on Saturday.

crypto_headlines.title: Russia greenlights retail BTC, ETH and USDT trading from Nov 17
crypto_headlines.summary: Russia's central bank approved non-qualified retail trading of Bitcoin, Ethereum and USDT starting November 17, capped at about 300,000 rubles per year per broker with a knowledge test. Moscow Exchange plans related trading from December 1.

crypto_headlines.title: Strive posts $509M Q3 profit and grows Bitcoin holdings to 43,124 BTC
crypto_headlines.summary: The Nasdaq-listed Bitcoin treasury firm reported $509M in Q3 net income, driven mainly by unrealized Bitcoin gains, and said it added thousands of BTC in Q3 and October to reach 43,124 BTC.

crypto_headlines.title: First U.S. staked INJ ETF (INJC) lists on Nasdaq; Injective rings the bell
crypto_headlines.summary: Canary Capital's staked Injective ETF began trading on Nasdaq under ticker INJC, targeting staking of most holdings and passing rewards through brokerage accounts. Injective and Canary rang the Nasdaq opening bell on November 6.

crypto_headlines.title: Third Stacks Bitcoin staking bond fills with 1,005 BTC from institutions
crypto_headlines.summary: The third Stacks Bitcoin staking bond sold out with 1,005 BTC committed, led by Bullish and 21Shares, bringing the three-round total to about 1,740 BTC locked for a target ~3% annual yield paid in BTC.

doginal_news.title: Floor still parked at 47k DOGE with listings thin
doginal_news.summary: Community tracker BradX's early Saturday bag check says the Dogs book stayed quiet: floor still at 47k DOGE with listings thin or paused after Friday's majors selloff.

doginal_news.title: Wizard Dogs: Broom Rush hits the Apple App Store
doginal_news.summary: Community builder Rollmeta says his first game, Wizard Dogs: Broom Rush, is live on the App Store and posted a corrected direct link after an earlier one broke; SwitchMetaX asked the pack to at least load it.

doginal_news.title: AGS grading live; same-day slabs planned at DD Miami Collectors Club
doginal_news.summary: homeMetaX says AGS grading for Doginal Dogs Legends cards is live, with same-day on-site grading planned at Collectors Club during DD Miami.

doginal_news.title: homeMetaX joins the DDLTCG council
doginal_news.summary: Collector homeMetaX posted that he will participate on the Legends TCG council and help put pack knowledge to work.

doginal_news.title: Pyth Pro expands US equities, 24/7 indices, ag and crypto feeds
doginal_news.summary: Pyth Network announced a Pyth Pro expansion adding more US equities and ETFs, 24/7 Pyth Indices across global markets, expanded agricultural indices and cotton futures, plus additional crypto and redemption rates.

doginal_news.title: PIRB: Pyth as the fastest-growing data company, quoting the $13.6M ARR year
doginal_news.summary: Pyth's community account posted a video meme calling Pyth the fastest-growing data company, quoting a thread on the fee switch, Pro monetization, $13.6M ARR and a first $1M month.

notes: No new original posts from @doginaldogs or @DDLTCG in the last ~24 hours. No news on Atlas or Boogie; Toot appears only in homeMetaX binder art (master set page 19). Floor note is community tracking, not an official listing figure. Wizard Dogs is a community App Store game, not an official @doginaldogs release.
